notes: CausalForestDML uses cross-fitting (cv=5) to partial out nuisance functions before estimating heterogeneous treatment effects. Outcome is raw spend (zero-inflated); forest handles this implicitly. ATE = average across all customers. CATE = individual estimates. CI computed at 90% level. Stage 4 will combine Stage 2 conversion uplift with Stage 3 CATE to produce expected incremental revenue per customer.
